rationale: All 10 acceptance criteria pass. The diff applies the established FeatureGuard wrapping pattern consistently across favoritesRoutes and five settingsRoutes. No new correctness, security, or regression issues are introduced. All raised edge cases (loading race, mcpConnect prefix, config fetch failure behavior, element vs Component semantics) are pre-existing patterns present in the already-guarded analyticsRoutes — not regressions from this change.
follow_ups: defer: FeatureGuard does not check isConfigFetched internally — safe today because App.tsx gates the Outlet, but fragile if routes are ever moved outside that tree
defer: fetchCustomerConfig fail-closed behavior (empty configs on network error) could silently disable all guarded routes; consider retry or fail-open on error
